hints: Start by counting: how many pieces total?
Name the reference edge first — which row faces you?
The rod's two ends each plug into a connector. Say which side of each connector.
challenges.referenceOrientation: The front edge (row 1) faces you. Columns A (left) to H (right).
challenges.title: First Steps
challenges.buildDescription: Place one straight connector so its two openings face left and right. Connect a red rod (length 3) to its right opening so the rod runs left-to-right. Connect a second straight connector to the right end of the rod, with its openings facing left and right.

hints: The elbow connector is the key piece — which two directions do its openings face?
Build the horizontal arm first, then the vertical arm.
Say whether each rod runs left-right or front-back.
challenges.referenceOrientation: The front edge (row 1) faces you. Columns A (left) to H (right).
challenges.title: The Corner
challenges.buildDescription: Place an elbow connector with its openings facing back and right. Connect a blue rod (length 2) to the right opening, running left-to-right, and cap its far end with a straight connector (openings facing left and right). Connect a second blue rod (length 2) to the back opening, running front-to-back, and cap its far end with a straight connector (openings facing front and back).

hints: Notice the symmetry: the left and right sides mirror each other.
Describe one post completely, then say 'mirror it on the right.'
The two elbows face different directions — which way does each opening point?
challenges.referenceOrientation: The front edge (row 1) faces you. Columns A (left) to H (right).
challenges.title: The Gate
challenges.buildDescription: Place two yellow rods (length 3) running front-to-back, three squares apart — one on the left, one on the right. Cap the front end of each with a straight connector (openings facing front and back). At the back end of the left rod, place an elbow with openings facing front and right; at the back end of the right rod, place an elbow with openings facing front and left. Join the two elbows with a yellow rod (length 3) running left-to-right.

hints: The T connector has three openings and one closed side — which side is closed?
The stem attaches to the middle of the bar, not the end.
Count the rods: two form the bar, one forms the stem.
learningObjectives: Distinguish the stem from the bar
challenges.referenceOrientation: The front edge (row 1) faces you. Columns A (left) to H (right).
challenges.title: T-Junction
challenges.buildDescription: Build the bar: lay a green rod (length 2) running left-to-right. Attach a T connector to its right end with the closed side facing front (openings face back, left, and right). Attach a second green rod (length 2) to the T's right opening, running left-to-right. Cap both free ends of the bar with straight connectors (openings facing left and right). Build the stem: attach a green rod (length 2) to the T's back opening, running front-to-back, and cap its far end with a straight connector (openings facing front and back).

hints: Trace the path with your finger: right, then back, then left.
The two elbows are mirror images — describe each one's openings.
The two horizontal rods sit on different rows. Name both rows.
challenges.referenceOrientation: The front edge (row 1) faces you. Columns A (left) to H (right).
challenges.title: Zigzag
challenges.buildDescription: Place a straight connector with openings facing left and right. Attach a red rod (length 2) to its right opening, running left-to-right. Attach an elbow to the rod's right end with openings facing left and back. Attach a red rod (length 2) to the elbow's back opening, running front-to-back. Attach a second elbow to the rod's back end with openings facing front and left. Attach a red rod (length 2) to this elbow's left opening, running left-to-right, and cap the free end with a straight connector (openings facing left and right).

hints: All four corners are elbows, but each faces a different direction.
Go around the square clockwise and name each corner's openings.
A loop has no loose ends — every rod end must plug into a corner.
challenges.referenceOrientation: The front edge (row 1) faces you. Columns A (left) to H (right).
challenges.title: The Square
challenges.buildDescription: Build a square loop, going clockwise from the front-left corner. Place an elbow with openings facing back and right. Attach a yellow rod (length 2) to its right opening, running left-to-right. Attach an elbow with openings facing back and left. Attach a yellow rod (length 2) to its back opening, running front-to-back. Attach an elbow with openings facing front and left. Attach a yellow rod (length 2) to its left opening, running left-to-right. Attach an elbow with openings facing front and right. Attach a final yellow rod (length 2) to its front opening, running front-to-back, closing the loop.

hints: The cross connector has four openings — one per arm.
Describe the center first, then go arm by arm: front, back, left, right.
All four rods are identical. What keeps them distinct is direction.
challenges.referenceOrientation: The front edge (row 1) faces you. Columns A (left) to H (right).
challenges.title: Crossroads
challenges.buildDescription: Place a cross connector at the center. Attach four blue rods (length 2), one to each opening — front, back, left, and right. Cap each rod's free end with a straight connector: front-back openings for the front and back rods, left-right openings for the left and right rods.

hints: Build the vertical mast bottom-to-top first.
The two T connectors are stacked — one arm points right, the other points left.
For each T, name which side is closed. That's what distinguishes them.
challenges.referenceOrientation: The front edge (row 1) faces you. Columns A (left) to H (right).
challenges.title: Double-T Antenna
challenges.buildDescription: Build a vertical mast from front to back. Start with a straight connector (openings facing front and back). Attach a green rod (length 2), running front-to-back. Attach a T connector with its closed side facing left (openings face front, back, and right). Attach another green rod (length 2), running front-to-back. Attach a second T connector with its closed side facing right (openings face front, back, and left). Finish with a straight connector (openings facing front and back). Now the arms: to the first T's right opening, attach a green rod (length 2) running left-to-right, capped with a straight connector (openings left-right). To the second T's left opening, attach a green rod (length 2) running left-to-right, capped with a straight connector (openings left-right).

hints: Each step is the same shape: flat, turn, up, turn, flat.
Describe the first step fully, then say how the second step shifts.
Watch the elbows — each turn needs its openings named.
challenges.referenceOrientation: The front edge (row 1) faces you. Columns A (left) to H (right).
challenges.title: Staircase
challenges.buildDescription: Start at the front-left with a straight connector (openings facing left and right). Attach a red rod (length 2) to its right opening, running left-to-right. Attach an elbow with openings facing left and back. Attach a red rod (length 2) to its back opening, running front-to-back. Attach an elbow with openings facing front and right. Attach a red rod (length 2) to its right opening, running left-to-right. Attach an elbow with openings facing left and back. Attach a final red rod (length 2) to its back opening, running front-to-back, and cap the end with a straight connector (openings facing front and back).

hints: Three parts: the base, the pole, the flag. Describe them in that order.
The T connector joins the base to the pole — which side of the T is closed?
The flag hangs off the top of the pole. Which way does the elbow turn?
learningObjectives: Describe base, pole, and flag separately
challenges.practiceNote: Practice simulation — piece counts and layout are original, not the official 2027 tournament setup.
challenges.referenceOrientation: The front edge (row 1) faces you. Columns A (left) to H (right).
challenges.title: The Flag
challenges.buildDescription: Build the base: a straight connector (openings facing left and right), then a blue rod (length 2) running left-to-right, then a T connector with its closed side facing front (openings face back, left, and right). Attach a blue rod (length 2) to the T's right opening, running left-to-right, then a straight connector (openings facing left and right). Raise the pole: attach a blue rod (length 3) to the T's back opening, running front-to-back. At the top of the pole, attach an elbow with openings facing front and left. Attach a red rod (length 2) to its left opening, running left-to-right, and cap the end with a straight connector (openings facing left and right).
